In countries like Zimbabwe, where the local currency has collapsed, creators need to convert Bitcoin to naira or other local currencies quickly to meet their financial obligations. This post explains how to use Cloudflare Workers crypto payment webhooks to receive USDT payments on Tron or Solana, with fees under $0.10 per transaction, and convert them to local currencies like naira, Ghanaian cedis, or Kenyan shillings.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies across multiple blockchain networks. For practical digital product sales, the most operationally useful options are USDT on Tron — fastest settlement under 60 seconds, fees under $0.10, widely held in restricted markets — USDT on Ethereum — higher fees but the most widely supported chain globally — Bitcoin — highest global recognition, 10 to 60 minute confirmation depending on network congestion — Solana — fast settlement, fees of fractions of a cent, growing adoption — and BNB on Binance Smart Chain — popular in Southeast Asia and widely available through Binance.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture works by integrating Cloudflare Workers with NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment processor that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook sends a notification to the Cloudflare Workers script, which then updates the order status and sends a confirmation email to the customer. This process is end-to-end encrypted, ensuring the security and integrity of the transaction.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who sell digital products in regions with restricted payment infrastructure, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Zimbabwe. These creators need a reliable and cost-effective way to receive crypto payments and convert them to local currencies. The Cloudflare Workers crypto payment webhooks architecture provides a sovereign solution that puts creators in control of their finances and reduces their reliance on traditional payment platforms.
Cloudflare Workers crypto payment webhooks provide a sovereign solution for digital creators in regions with restricted payment infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. There is no monthly fee, no setup fee, no payout fee, and no minimum transaction volume requirement. Network fees for the underlying blockchain transaction are paid by the buyer and vary by network — Tron fees are under $0.10, Solana fees are fractions of a cent, Bitcoin fees average $1 to $5 for most transactions. For a $97 product sold through the Sovereign Starter Stack, the total transaction cost is approximately $0.49 to NOWPayments plus network fees typically under $0.10 on Tron. Compare this to Gumroad's 10% fee on the same transaction — $9.70.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this solution today, creators can start by signing up for a Cloudflare account and setting up a Cloudflare Workers script. Next, they can integrate NOWPayments with their Cloudflare Workers script and configure Supabase to store order information. Finally, they can deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, to get started with receiving USDT payments on Tron or Solana.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

The most important question a reader would ask is: how long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal? The answer is that USDT payments on Tron and Solana are processed in under 10 minutes, while PayPal payments can take 3-5 business days to arrive. This makes USDT payments a more reliable and faster option for creators in regions with restricted payment infrastructure.
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% on all transactions, making it a cost-effective option for creators who want to receive USDT payments on Tron or Solana.

For digital creators who want to take their online store to the next level, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is designed to provide a seamless user experience, fast load times, and robust security features. By deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can receive USDT payments on Tron or Solana and convert them to local currencies like naira, Ghanaian cedis, or Kenyan shillings. To learn more about the Edge Commerce Stack, visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the Cloudflare Workers crypto payment webhooks solution today, follow these concrete deployment steps: set up a Cloudflare account and create a new Workers script, integrate NOWPayments with your Workers script, configure Supabase to store order information, set up SPF, DKIM, and DMARC on your domain, and deploy the Edge Commerce Stack to get started with receiving USDT payments on Tron or Solana.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a Cloudflare Workers script?

To set up a Cloudflare Workers script, create a new account on Cloudflare, then navigate to the Workers tab and follow the prompts to create a new script. From there, you can integrate NOWPayments and configure Supabase to store order information.
What is the fee structure for NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% on all transactions, making it a cost-effective option for creators who want to receive USDT payments on Tron or Solana. This fee structure is significantly lower than traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal.
Can I use this solution to receive Bitcoin payments?

Yes, you can use this solution to receive Bitcoin payments, but you will need to integrate a cryptocurrency conversion service to convert Bitcoin to USDT or other local currencies. This can be done using a service like NOWPayments or a third-party cryptocurrency conversion service.
How do I configure Supabase to store order information?

To configure Supabase, create a new account on Supabase, then navigate to the dashboard and follow the prompts to create a new database. From there, you can integrate your Cloudflare Workers script with Supabase to store order information.
Can I use this solution with other cryptocurrency payment processors?

Yes, you can use this solution with other cryptocurrency payment processors, but you will need to integrate them with your Cloudflare Workers script and configure Supabase to store order information. Some popular alternatives to NOWPayments include Coinbase Commerce and Bitpay.
